sections.description:
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL COUNCILS SERVANTS (TRANSFER) RULES,
1980 (Amendment)
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL COUNCILS SERVANTS (TRANSFER)
RULES, 1980 (Amendment)
No.
Admn (LG) I (3t)/84.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 172 of the North-West Frontier Province Local Government
Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W. F. P. Ordinance IV of 1979), read with section 49
thereof, the Government of the North-West Frontier Province is pleased to
direct that in the North-West Frontier Province Local Councils Servants
(Transfer) Rules, 1980, the following amendment shall be made, namely----
1.
In rules 1(2), 2(d) and 3(2), for the figure "8", wherever occurring,
the figure "5" shall be substituted.
